intl_finance.document: Certification of Financial Responsibility (CFR), an online form with instructions sent after admission; the FSU Center for Global Engagement separately asks for funding documents (bank statement, letter or scholarship letter) and a signed International Funding Document (IFD) with the I-20 application

deadlines.label: I-20 application opens about 2 business days after formal admission
deadlines.note: No fixed calendar date published. The CFR instructions arrive “Shortly after admission.”

intl_finance.notes: Two FSU offices describe the step differently: Admissions says CFR instructions arrive after admission and applicants must show proof of financial support for the first year; the Center for Global Engagement says the I-20 application needs the passport page, funding documentation dated within the past six months and in English, and a signed IFD. Bank statements must be on the institution’s letterhead showing account owner and available amount; letters must be signed by a manager. Check both pages after admission.

notes: Fact-check 2026-10-27: 'none' kept; source 1 (re-read) lists the 650-word essay on one of seven Common App-matching topics and a resume as the only writing, which fits the brief's rule for 'none'. FSU requires one essay of at most 650 words (choose from a list of seven topics that match the Common App personal statement prompts) and a resume of up to two pages, both uploaded to the Admissions Portal; FSU pulls them from the Common App for Common App applicants. No separate college-specific supplemental question is listed on sources 1 or 2, so supplements is none and no prompts are entered here. The checklist note on source 2 says additional supplemental applications or materials may be added to a student’s portal checklist (for example for talent-based majors); this file does not cover those. The cycle label comes from the live pages (2026 deadlines, Fall 2026 admit profile); the essay page does not print a cycle year. Source 4 lists cost estimates that change yearly; none are copied here.
